title: Q7
description:
“Though He was a Son, yet He learned obedience by the things which He suffered.”
Read: Psa 40:6–8, Isa 50:4–7, Heb 5:7
a) The Servant says, “The Lord Yahweh has opened My ear… I was not rebellious… I gave My back to those who struck Me.” What does that bring forward about what “learned obedience” means for a sinless Son?
